content.user_title: Manage Project Context for AI Development
content.value_statement: AI-assisted projects lose consistency when goals, workflows, and technical decisions are scattered. This skill helps teams create and maintain structured context artifacts beside the code.
actual_capabilities: Explains a Context to Spec and Plan to Implement workflow.
Defines core context artifacts such as product, tech stack, workflow, and tracks documents.
Guides greenfield and brownfield Conductor setup decisions.
Provides validation checklists before implementation begins.
Describes maintenance practices for keeping context synchronized.
limitations: It is documentation guidance and does not create files automatically.
It assumes the user understands the Conductor workflow.
It does not validate project code, dependencies, or CI configuration.
It references an optional playbook that is not present in this package.

use_cases.title: Start a new AI-assisted project
use_cases.description: Define product goals, technical choices, workflow rules, and track structure before implementation begins.

use_cases.title: Document an existing codebase
use_cases.description: Extract implicit product and technical context from current code and convert it into maintained artifacts.

use_cases.title: Onboard contributors
use_cases.description: Use context artifacts to help new team members and AI assistants follow the same project standards.

prompt_templates.title: Create context basics
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a new project
prompt_templates.prompt: Help me set up context-driven development for a new project. Ask for the product goal, target users, tech preferences, and workflow expectations.

prompt_templates.title: Review existing context
prompt_templates.prompt: Review my project context artifacts for consistency. Identify stale, missing, or conflicting information before I start the next track.

prompt_templates.title: Convert a brownfield project
prompt_templates.prompt: Guide me through creating context artifacts for an existing codebase. Focus on product intent, current stack, workflows, and technical debt.

prompt_templates.title: Maintain context across releases
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a context maintenance process for my team. Include review points, ownership, update triggers, and validation checks for each release.

output_examples.input: I am starting a new SaaS project and need durable AI context.
output_examples.output: A guided setup sequence covering product vision, target users, technical preferences, workflow rules, and an initial track registry.

output_examples.input: Our project documents are stale after several feature releases.
output_examples.output: A context review plan that identifies outdated product goals, missing dependency updates, workflow drift, and track status corrections.

output_examples.input: A new developer needs to understand how our AI workflow operates.
output_examples.output: An onboarding checklist that explains context artifacts, active tracks, technical standards, and expected update practices.

best_practices: Read current context before planning or implementing any track.
Update context artifacts when product, stack, workflow, or track status changes.
Review context changes with the same care as code changes.
anti_patterns: Starting implementation before verifying context accuracy.
Creating scattered documents instead of maintaining one canonical artifact per topic.
Treating context files as one-time setup notes instead of living project assets.

faq.question: What problem does this skill solve?
faq.answer: It helps teams keep AI assistants aligned by storing project context in structured, maintained documents.

faq.question: Does this skill run Conductor commands?
faq.answer: No. It documents when a user may choose to run Conductor setup commands.

faq.question: Can I use it with an existing project?
faq.answer: Yes. It includes brownfield guidance for deriving context from existing code, configs, and documentation.

faq.question: What artifacts does it describe?
faq.answer: It describes product, product guidelines, tech stack, workflow, tracks, style guides, and track-level planning documents.

faq.question: Does it replace testing or code review?
faq.answer: No. It supports planning and alignment, but users still need project-specific validation and review.

faq.question: Which tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists compatibility with Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.
